responsive_assumptions.assumption: Follow the accepted Home responsive header behavior rather than creating collection-specific navigation behavior.
At narrow widths, preserve all five destinations using wrapping or horizontal scrolling rather than shrinking labels below legibility.
Desktop sidebar should collapse to a filter trigger/drawer on tablet/mobile while retaining Shopify facet behavior.
Three desktop columns reduce to two on tablet and one or two on mobile according to accepted Calder/Lumia responsive conventions and B1 minimum viable card width.
Reuse the accepted shared fitment component's existing responsive behavior; do not infer a new collection-only mobile form.

implementation_notes: Approved collection mockup is authority for page-specific composition; accepted Home is authority for shared Calder design language.
Reuse the established Calder container system; known project context sets --container-max-width: 1178px.
Reuse Facundo for display/headings and Garet for UI/body with Poppins fallback where already established; verify exact accepted implementation classes/tokens before editing.
Map screenshot colors to existing Calder brand tokens instead of sampling near-duplicate values.
Preserve dynamic Shopify collection data, facets, sorting, pagination and product links.
Reuse B1 product card internally; do not create a collection-specific card fork.
Reuse fitment behavior; collection may present a compact entry treatment only if that is how the existing shared component supports the reference.
Do not alter accepted Home/shared components unless a change is safe for all consumers.
Capture v1 desktop render at the approved comparison viewport and optional tablet/mobile renders for responsive QA.
